items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: So I arranged to go out to the Cotton Club with Nyus Berry.

ctx.x: So, I say he's got to be playing a slide trumpet to make it come out like that. And the guys in the band said no, he's not playing a slide trumpet, it's the same just like your, the same trumpet. So I said, no, I've got to see it, you know. And Matt had told me down in New Orleans they did that but didn't tell anybody how they did it. They put a handkerchief over their face so nobody could see them do it.

So I didn't know whether Louis would tell me how he did it anyway. But anyway, the Berry Brothers were working out at the Cotton Club. So I arranged to go out to the Cotton Club with Nyus Berry. And I went out early and went back stage and everybody's putting on their costumes and they took me in Louis' room.

And Louis was very nice. He signed his picture for me. And I said, Mr. Armstrong, I said, will you show me how you do this on the trumpet? Well at first he showed me his horn. It was just like mine.
